title: 1952 Train wreck from washout lower Brighton
description: A track washout caused a derailment at 1 a.m. in 1952 at Acker’s Creek, resulting in the deaths of two Aroostook Junction CPR railmen, the engineer and the brakeman, when a seventeen-car northbound freight train carrying fertilizer and gasoline plunged into the river. The water was high and swift at the freshet level. Ten cars derailed; eight were partially or fully submerged, and the locomotive was completely underwater.
